body:
Preserves the existing reviewed STK-46 slice for handover. This is a scoped draft; no merge or production deployment is authorized. Stacked on `feature/stk-46-design-continue`; it requires that dependency before main integration. Validation below is carried from the exact reviewed source artifacts, not a new exact-commit CI claim. Current-main integration and aggregate validation remain pending; PermissionCatalogue/TEAM overlap STK50/51 and other approved work.

# STK-46 retrospective valuation and report notices

Status: implementation, independent Billing source review, focused checks, production build/types and live synthetic visual/download checks complete. Designer independently reviewed all four notice screenshots at 390/1440 px in light/dark; no bounded visual blocker.

This overlay applies to main 23639679e plus the approved service patch `fe79e7816b881dcdc2a7cefcbe6329b4e6cb90e97472a0b8a47723a60fcc520b`. It adds no migration, permission or existing-test assertion change. Exact overlay: `/workspace/inventory-review/stk46-replay.patch` (source hashes in `stk46-replay/source-manifest.json`). The approved inventory_hand_costs table must exist before deploying the reader.

## Behavior

The latest accepted cost (decision time, then ID) replaces an eligible opening's missing cost or a purchase receipt's missing/estimated cost at its original movement date. Waiting/rejected entries have no effect. Actual costs remain authoritative. A zero accepted total is a known zero cost, not missing. History is replayed from the start; acceptance after the requested reporting period still restates that period.

Accepted history remains in replay after a subsequent receipt correction. Reversal uses the existing average-cost policy: 10 units at RM10 plus 10 received with accepted RM20/unit gives 20 units at RM15; reversing 10 leaves 10 units worth RM150, not RM100. The provenance remains on that residual.

Provenance follows averages, outflows, direct transfers and partial in-transit arrivals. A depleted costed pool clears current-position provenance; historical movements retain their consumed provenance. The existing result shape and figures are unchanged when no accepted cost contributes.

Stock value data and monthly journal opening/closing figures include scoped Changed on notices. Notices also cover a current-period supplier credit referring to an earlier return movement. The journal CSV includes the notices as metadata, preserving existing columns and balancing rules. The page shows a conditional, quiet information block below the existing accounting banner, per independent designer sketch. Private hand-cost notes, references and checker identities are not included.

## Evidence

- Pure WAC old+new: 11 tests / 380 assertions, pass.
- Focused Feature old+new: 29 tests / 353 assertions, pass. Includes historical closing and following opening restatement, accepted replacement tie-break, ignored waiting/rejected, unchanged ledger, CSV notice/privacy, actual receipt correction retaining accepted history, branch/transit/outflow notice scope and timezone.
- Scoped PHPStan: zero errors.
- Billing independent source review: no blocker; no source edits or test reruns by reviewer.
- Designer supplied layout sketch before UI change and independently reviewed the notice (bounded review; no blocker).
- Frontend vue-tsc, production build, file ESLint/Prettier and focused existing frontend checks pass.
- Live synthetic preview 3038: four screenshots at 1440/390 light/dark, HTTP200, exact viewport scroll widths, zero JS errors. Actual journal download button produces HTTP200 CSV with both Changed on notices. Evidence in `stk46-replay/visual/`.
- Own preview migration/seed and synthetic fixture pass; effective DB verified 127.0.0.1:55439/kpone_stk46_replay_preview_test before HTTP. Initial router cwd error and fixture role-branch mismatch were corrected in preview harness only; no source change needed.
- No full backend suite run in this slice; coordinator owns shared full gate.

Entry/checking UI is a later slice. No commits, push, PR, merge or production changes made.


Publication update: owner authorized commit/push/draft publication on26 November2026. Historical statements above saying no commit/PR describe the pre-publication validation. No additional implementation or existing assertion changes were made during this preservation.
